title.zh: 将塔克洛班市San Jose描笼涯中学的名称正式变更为San Jose国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the San Jose Barangay High School in Tacloban City to San Jose National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the San Jose Barangay High School in Tacloban City to San Jose National High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên San Jose Barangay High School in Tacloban City thành Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia San Jose
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ San Jose Barangay High School in Tacloban City เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ San Jose
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama San Jose Barangay High School in Tacloban City menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional San Jose
title.ms: Akta menukar nama San Jose Barangay High School in Tacloban City menjadi Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan San Jose

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6751_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the San Jose Barangay High School in Tacloban City is hereby changed to San Jose National High School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.

titleTranslation.source: An Act Changing the Name of the San Jose Barangay High School in Tacloban City to San Jose National High School
